userStories.title: Run outcome rows at bundle ingest
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Persist bounded RUN feature reports and decisions as epoch-scoped outcome rows during bundle ingest.

**Motivation** — Every workflow-mode RUN ends with a feature report (what was built, what review found, what the branch fix changed) and a decisions log (each advisor ruling with its rationale).

**Approach** — 3c-2-D1 (outcome rows): migration `20261021090000_fleet_run_outcomes` adds

```prisma
model FleetRunOutcome {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  jobId      String
  leaseEpoch Int
  projectId  String
  repoId     String
  kind       String   // report | decisions
  content    String   @db.Text
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  job        FleetJob @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  @@unique([jobId, leaseEpoch, kind])
  @@index([projectId])
}
```

and `FleetJob` gains the back-relation `runOutcomes FleetRunOutcome[]`. `BundleFiles` (`apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/bundle-reader.ts:11-20`) gains two optional fields `featureReport?: BundleFile | null` and `decisions?: BundleFile | null` (optional so existing `BundleFiles` literals in specs still type-check); `readBundleFiles` always sets both, null when absent. `SLOTS` gains `[/^workflow\/feature-report\.md$/, 'featureReport']` and `[/^workflow\/decisions\.jsonl$/, 'decisions']`; both are single-file slots like `workflowResult`, and the existing `INGEST_LIMITS.fileBytes` oversized rule applies. `IngestRows` (`apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/domain/bundle-ingest.domain.ts:108-112`) gains `outcomes?: readonly RunOutcomeRow[]` with `RunOutcomeRow = { kind: 'report' | 'decisions'; content: string }`. `parseBundle` puts a `report` row for a non-empty `featureReport` text and a `decisions` row for a non-empty `decisions` text into `rows.outcomes`, each `content` cut to `RUN_OUTCOME_MAX_CHARS = 262_144` characters; the per-file `files` record and the `partial` rule are unchanged. `BundleIngestService.write` (`bundle-ingest.service.ts:75-105`) passes `rows.outcomes` to `replaceRows` only when `job.command === 'RUN'`, else an empty list, and its transaction result carries `isRun` for the post-commit hook of D8. The `readBundleFiles` accumulator (`bundle-reader.ts:58`) starts both new fields at null, and its entry handler (`:80-83`) assigns them as single files, like `workflowResult`. `PrismaBundleIngestRepository.replaceRows` (`prisma-bundle-ingest.repository.ts:52-73`) also deletes the job's `FleetRunOutcome` rows of `ctx.leaseEpoch` and creates one row per outcome with `ctx.projectId` and `ctx.repoId`; an absent `rows.outcomes` counts as an empty list. `INGEST_PARSER_VERSION` (`domain/bundle-ingest.domain.ts:7`) becomes 3. The schema change is in `apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma`; the client is regenerated with `bun run db:generate` (the generated client is not committed).

**Scope** — In: the outcome model/migration, reader allowlist/accumulator, pure bounded extraction, transactional per-epoch replacement and RUN-only gating, parser-version bump, and associated unit/PG behavior tests. Change the obsolete bundle-reader.spec.ts report/decisions exclusion expectation to slot mappings; leave the workflow result test unchanged. In parsers/workflow.parser.spec.ts change only the version-2 assertion to version 3. Out: the KnowledgeIndexQueue constructor dependency and post-commit enqueue belong to US-004; patterns to US-002; decisions chunking to US-003; projection/search/tools/web to US-004..US-007. Outcomes are indexed only for RUN jobs; PLAN, CONFIG_EDIT, CONFIG_DRIFT and THREAD jobs produce none. Calling the re-run-outdated route after deploy is a deployment step, not story work; indexing must be enabled first, or the re-ingest queues no outcome pass.

**Interface** — `featureReport?: BundleFile | null`; `decisions?: BundleFile | null`; `outcomes?: readonly RunOutcomeRow[]`; `RunOutcomeRow = { kind: 'report' | 'decisions'; content: string }`; `RUN_OUTCOME_MAX_CHARS = 262_144`; `INGEST_PARSER_VERSION = 3`. Keep `readBundleFiles(bundle)` and `replaceRows(ctx, rows)` call signatures compatible with existing callers.

**Verification** — Extend existing bundle-reader.spec.ts, parse-bundle.spec.ts, bundle-ingest.outcomes.spec.ts and fleet-ingest-repository.integration.spec.ts; actual repository persistence, epoch isolation and cascade cases require real Postgres with KODA_DB_TESTS=1. Reuse the tar-gz helper for the end-to-end gzipped reader path.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] slotOf('workflow/feature-report.md') answers featureReport and slotOf('workflow/decisions.jsonl') answers decisions, while slotOf('workflow/x/feature-report.md') answers null.

[unit] readBundleFiles on a gzipped tar holding workflow/feature-report.md (text '# R') and workflow/decisions.jsonl returns featureReport { name: 'workflow/feature-report.md', text: '# R' } and a decisions file with that entry's text.
[unit] readBundleFiles on a bundle with neither file returns featureReport: null and decisions: null.
[unit] parseBundle with a featureReport text '# R' and a decisions text of one line returns rows.outcomes equal to [{ kind: 'report', content: '# R' }, { kind: 'decisions', content: <the line> }].
[unit] parseBundle with a featureReport of 262200 characters returns a report outcome whose content is the first 262144 characters.
[unit] parseBundle with an empty featureReport text and no decisions returns rows.outcomes as an empty list, and its files record and partial value equal those of the same bundle without the report.
[integration] PrismaBundleIngestRepository.replaceRows with outcome rows for (job, leaseEpoch 1) creates one FleetRunOutcome row per outcome carrying the context's projectId and repoId.
[integration] A second replaceRows for the same (job, leaseEpoch 1) with only a report outcome leaves exactly that one FleetRunOutcome row, and a row of leaseEpoch 2 of the same job is untouched.
[integration] Deleting a FleetJob deletes its FleetRunOutcome rows.
[unit] BundleIngestService.ingestOne for a claimed RUN job whose bundle has a feature report calls replaceRows with rows.outcomes holding the report row.
[unit] ingestOne for a claimed PLAN job whose bundle has a feature report calls replaceRows with rows.outcomes empty.
[unit] INGEST_PARSER_VERSION equals 3.

routing.reasoning: Additive fields, one child table and bounded text extraction extend the existing ingest transaction and replacement pattern; the several edits stay within one established workflow and add no new authorization or concurrency abstraction.

modifiedFiles.reason: the test `AC-8 keeps workflow reports and decisions unallowlisted` at `:11-14` asserts `slotOf` is null for the workflow feature report and the workflow decisions log; it becomes a test that they map to the slots `featureReport` and `decisions`. The workflow result test at `:8-10` is unchanged.
the test `AC-15 is version 2` at `:64` asserts `INGEST_PARSER_VERSION` is 2; it asserts 3 after the D1 bump. Nothing else in the file changes.

userStories.title: Per-project path patterns
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Let global admins replace the default project Markdown corpus with validated patterns and make every repository re-select against the saved configuration.

**Motivation** — The fixed 3c-1 allowlist also cannot be narrowed or extended per project: koda's own repository spends most of its indexing time on `docs/superpowers/plans/*`, and a project whose docs live under `handbook/` cannot be indexed at all.

**Approach** — 3c-2-D2 (patterns): `apps/api/src/fleet/knowledge/knowledge-patterns.ts` (pure) exports `DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_PATTERNS: readonly string[] = ['README.md', '.nax/context.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'docs/**/*.md', '.nax/features/*/spec.md']`, `matchesKnowledgePattern(path: string, pattern: string): boolean` and `parseKnowledgePatterns(input: unknown): { ok: true; value: string[] } | { ok: false; reason: string }`. Matching splits the pattern and the path at `/`: a `**` segment matches zero or more whole path segments, `*` inside a segment matches any run of characters other than `/`, every other character matches itself. `parseKnowledgePatterns` accepts an array of 1 to 50 strings; each is trimmed and must be 1 to 200 characters, end with `.md`, use only `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - * /`, not start with `/`, have no empty segment, no `.` or `..` segment, and use `**` only as a whole segment; the first failing entry answers `{ ok: false, reason: 'patterns[<i>]' }` (a non-array or an array outside 1-50 answers `reason: 'patterns'`). Duplicates are removed, first kept.
`selectIndexableEntries` (`knowledge-allowlist.ts:27`) gains an optional second parameter `patterns?: readonly string[]`: when given, an entry is indexable when it matches any pattern; when absent the 3c-1 `isIndexablePath` rule decides, unchanged. The `AGENTS.md`-beside-`.nax/context.md` rule, the size, safe-path and 2000-file rules apply either way.
Migration `20261021091000_knowledge_project_patterns` adds `model KnowledgeProjectPatterns { projectId String @id; patterns Json; updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt; project Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade) }` and `Project` gains `knowledgePatterns KnowledgeProjectPatterns?`. `IKnowledgeIndexRepository` (`knowledge-index.domain.ts`) gains `findProjectPatterns(projectId): Promise<string[] | null>`, `saveProjectPatterns(projectId, patterns: string[] | null): Promise<void>` (null deletes the row). The same migration adds `patternsKey String?` to `KnowledgeRepoIndex`, and `KnowledgeIndexState` and `KnowledgeFinishResult` gain `patternsKey?: string | null` (`finish` writes it when given, like `indexedSha`). A pattern list's key is `knowledgePatternsKey(patterns: readonly string[] | null): string` in `knowledge-patterns.ts`: `default` for null, else the patterns joined by a newline. `KnowledgeIndexService` gains `getPatterns(projectId): Promise<{ patterns: string[]; custom: boolean }>` (the stored list, else `DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_PATTERNS` with `custom: false`) and `savePatterns(projectId, patterns: string[] | null): Promise<{ patterns: string[]; custom: boolean }>`.
`KnowledgeRepoIndexer.indexRepo` reads `findProjectPatterns(repo.projectId)` after the claim, passes a non-null list to `selectIndexableEntries`, and computes the pass's key with `knowledgePatternsKey`. The unchanged short-circuit (`knowledge-repo-indexer.ts:78`) additionally requires the stored `patternsKey` to equal that key, and the idle finish (`:118`) writes it. A pass that started before a save therefore records the old key, and the next pass re-selects; a row written before this feature has a null key, so its first pass re-selects (files whose blob sha is unchanged are still skipped, step 8 of 1c-c-D9).

3c-2-D3 (pattern routes): `ProjectKnowledgeController` gains `PUT patterns` (`@RequiredPermission('ADMIN')`, the reindex route's permission, HTTP 200), body `KnowledgePatternsBodyDto` = `{ patterns: string[] | null }` declared `@Allow() @ApiProperty({ nullable: true, type: [String] }) patterns` (the `KnowledgeSearchBodyDto` pattern, `project-knowledge.controller.ts:18-23`, so the global whitelisting pipe keeps the field); any other body, or a list `parseKnowledgePatterns` rejects, answers 400 `knowledge.input` with `{ reason }`. It calls `savePatterns`, then, when `knowledgeIndexEnabled`, enqueues every `listProjectRepos(projectId)` repository with reason `admin`, and answers `{ patterns, custom, queued }` where `queued` is the number of repositories enqueued (0 when disabled). It answers even when indexing is disabled. `GET repos` gains `patterns: string[]`, `customPatterns: boolean` and `defaultPatterns: string[]` (from `getPatterns` and `DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_PATTERNS`).

**Scope** — In: pure matching/validation/key helpers; project patterns migration/state/repository/service; pass snapshot and invalidation; ADMIN PUT and expanded GET DTOs; API tests and generated contracts. Add the indexer state's findProjectPatterns stub and stored patternsKey='default' to the unchanged-head fixture without changing its unchanged/indexed assertions; add getPatterns to both controller index stubs and pattern fields to exact repos payloads, preserving all other assertions. Run bun run db:generate. Regenerate root openapi.json with bun run api:export-spec and the ignored CLI client with bun run generate; never hand-edit generated clients. Out: outcome reads/projection/queue trigger in US-004, source-filtered search in US-005, tools in US-006, and the editor/citation UI in US-007. No pattern syntax beyond `*` and `**`: no `?`, character classes, braces or negation, and patterns select Markdown (`.md`) files only. Patterns are per project, not per repository. US-002 only: saving patterns does not delete the chunks of files the new patterns exclude until each repository's next pass runs.

**Interface** — `DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_PATTERNS: readonly string[] = ['README.md', '.nax/context.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'docs/**/*.md', '.nax/features/*/spec.md']`; `matchesKnowledgePattern(path: string, pattern: string): boolean`; `parseKnowledgePatterns(input: unknown): { ok: true; value: string[] } | { ok: false; reason: string }`; `knowledgePatternsKey(patterns: readonly string[] | null): string`; `findProjectPatterns(projectId): Promise<string[] | null>`; `saveProjectPatterns(projectId, patterns: string[] | null): Promise<void>`; `getPatterns(projectId): Promise<{ patterns: string[]; custom: boolean }>`; `savePatterns(projectId, patterns: string[] | null): Promise<{ patterns: string[]; custom: boolean }>`; `KnowledgePatternsBodyDto = { patterns: string[] | null }`; response `{ patterns, custom, queued }`.

**Verification** — Add knowledge-patterns.spec.ts; extend existing allowlist, indexer, Prisma repository and controller unit specs and knowledge-store.integration.spec.ts for persistence. Put HTTP cases in test/e2e/api-endpoint/endpoint.e2e.spec.ts, including global admin versus ordinary member and disabled indexing; use a stub queue at the route seam. Use a controlled running pass to prove that a concurrent save leaves the old snapshot key on that pass and forces re-selection on the next.

[unit] selectIndexableEntries(entries, ['handbook/*.md']) skips a handbook/big.md entry of 300000 bytes and reports skipped: 1.
[unit] KnowledgeRepoIndexer.indexRepo with findProjectPatterns answering ['handbook/*.md'] and a tree holding handbook/a.md and docs/b.md reads only handbook/a.md with getFile.

[unit] indexRepo whose head equals the stored indexedSha, with no unembedded file and a stored patternsKey of default, while findProjectPatterns answers ['handbook/*.md'], does not resolve unchanged and calls getTree.
[unit] An indexRepo pass that finishes idle with findProjectPatterns answering ['handbook/*.md'] calls finish with patternsKey: 'handbook/*.md', and with null calls it with patternsKey: 'default'.

[integration] PrismaKnowledgeIndexRepository.saveProjectPatterns(p, ['a/*.md']) then findProjectPatterns(p) answers ['a/*.md']; after saveProjectPatterns(p, null) it answers null; and a finish with patternsKey: 'x' is read back by listStates(p).

[integration] PUT /api/projects/:slug/knowledge/patterns as a global admin with { patterns: ['handbook/*.md'] }, with indexing enabled and a stubbed KnowledgeIndexQueue, answers 200 { patterns: ['handbook/*.md'], custom: true, queued: <the project's repository count> } and calls enqueue(<repoId>, 'admin') once per project repository.

[integration] PUT .../knowledge/patterns with { patterns: null } answers custom: false and patterns equal to DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_PATTERNS, and a following GET .../knowledge/repos answers customPatterns: false and defaultPatterns equal to DEFAULT_KNOWLEDGE_PATTERNS.
[integration] PUT .../knowledge/patterns with { patterns: ['src/a.ts'] } answers 400, and by a project member who is not a global admin answers 403 (one table-driven test).
[integration] PUT .../knowledge/patterns with indexing disabled answers 200 with queued: 0 and never calls enqueue.

userStories.title: Decisions chunker
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add a pure bounded JSONL-to-MarkdownChunk decisions chunker that shares document anchor rules.

**Motivation** — Every workflow-mode RUN ends with a feature report (what was built, what review found, what the branch fix changed) and a decisions log (each advisor ruling with its rationale).

**Approach** — 3c-2-D5 (decisions chunker): `chunkDecisions(text: string): MarkdownChunk[]` in `apps/api/src/fleet/knowledge/decisions-chunker.ts` is pure. Each non-empty line that parses as a JSON object with a string `id` is one chunk, in file order, at most `MAX_DECISION_CHUNKS = 1000` (later lines ignored, which keeps a decisions file under the chunk store's 2000-row read cap, `knowledge-chunk-store.ts:4`); other lines are skipped. A chunk has `chunkIndex` = its position from 0, `title` and `headingPath` = `Decision <id>`, `anchor` = the 1c-c-D8 anchor rule applied to `id` (`markdown-chunker.ts` exports its existing `slug` and `uniqueAnchor` helpers, `:215`, `:219`, for this) (lower-case, keep `a-z 0-9 space - _`, spaces to `-`; a repeated anchor gets `-1`, `-2`, ...), `abstract` = the first 300 characters of `rationale` (empty when absent), and `text` = these lines, each omitted when its values are absent: `Decision <id> (<kind>)`, `Question: <questionId>`, `Chosen: <chosenOptionId> -> <action.type>`, `Rationale: <rationale>`, `Decided: <decidedAt>` followed by ` by <model>` and `, confidence <confidence>` when those are present (the `Decided` line is omitted when `decidedAt` is absent). Values are read only when they are strings.

**Scope** — In: decisions-chunker.ts, exporting existing slug/uniqueAnchor without changing their behavior, and co-located chunker tests using real advisor field shapes. Out: bundle storage in US-001; repository/pattern work in US-002; embedding, LanceRecord construction, queue and ingest wiring in US-004; retrieval/tools/UI in US-005..US-007. No LLM-written summaries of outcomes; abstracts stay extractive (S5b-R14).

**Interface** — `chunkDecisions(text: string): MarkdownChunk[]`; `MAX_DECISION_CHUNKS = 1000`; consume the existing `MarkdownChunk` shape (`chunkIndex`, `title`, `headingPath`, `anchor`, `abstract`, `text`). Export existing helpers `slug(text: string): string` and `uniqueAnchor(base: string, counts: Map<string, number>, used: Set<string>): string`. Chunk zero is a decision, never a document summary.

**Verification** — Add decisions-chunker.spec.ts beside the pure implementation; table-driven malformed-line and duplicate-anchor cases, optional metadata rendering, ordered output and the accepted-chunk cap require no Nest DI, database or model calls. Preserve markdown-chunker.spec.ts regression behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] chunkDecisions on two lines {"id":"D-1","kind":"finish-approval","chosenOptionId":"A","action":{"type":"approve"},"rationale":"All green. Ship it."} and {"id":"D-2"} returns two chunks with chunkIndex 0 and 1, title Decision D-1 and Decision D-2, and anchor d-1 and d-2.

[unit] chunkDecisions on a line with id 'D-1', kind 'finish-approval', chosenOptionId 'A', action.type 'approve' and rationale 'All green. Ship it.' returns a chunk whose text is exactly the lines 'Decision D-1 (finish-approval)', 'Chosen: A -> approve' and 'Rationale: All green. Ship it.', and whose abstract is 'All green. Ship it.'.

[unit] chunkDecisions on a valid JSON object line with id 'D-1', decidedAt '2026-10-16T05:36:54Z', model 'm' and no confidence yields a chunk containing the text line 'Decided: 2026-10-16T05:36:54Z by m'.
[unit] chunkDecisions skips a line that is not JSON, a JSON array line and an object line without a string id, and returns chunks only for the valid lines.
[unit] chunkDecisions on two lines with id 'D 1' and 'd-1' returns anchors d-1 and d-1-1.
[unit] chunkDecisions on 1001 valid JSON object lines with ids D-1 through D-1001 in that order returns 1000 chunks, the last with title 'Decision D-1000' (the 1000th id).

[unit] After exporting the shared anchor helpers, chunkMarkdown({ path: 'docs/a.md', text: '# D 1' + '
' + 'a'.repeat(300) + '

## d-1' + '
' + 'b'.repeat(300) }) still returns anchors ['', 'd-1', 'd-1-1'] in chunkIndex order, preserving the summary chunk and the existing duplicate-heading suffix behavior.

routing.reasoning: Pure deterministic parsing plus small helper exports, with bounded iteration and existing anchor algorithms; no persistence, security-critical authorization or external integration.

suggestedCriteria: chunkDecisions returns an abstract of exactly the first 300 characters when rationale exceeds 300 characters, while retaining the full rationale in text.
chunkDecisions omits non-string optional field values rather than rendering object coercions or throwing.

userStories.title: Outcome indexing pass and ingest trigger
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Project latest-ingested RUN outcomes into the shared project knowledge table through a serialized post-commit ingest trigger.

**Motivation** — A thread asked "why did the knowledge index rebuild the FTS index only on the missing-index error" has the code but not the run that decided it.

**Approach** — 3c-2-D4 (outcome reads, outcome-lookup portion): `IKnowledgeIndexRepository` gains `findRunOutcomes(jobId): Promise<KnowledgeRunOutcomes | null>`. The knowledge repository reads fleet tables directly as its 3c-1 `findProjectRepos` already reads `FleetRepo`. This is a recorded exception to the cross-module rule of `.nax/rules/api-data.md` (call the owning module's service): `KnowledgeModule` cannot import `FleetJobsModule`, because `FleetJobsModule` imports `FleetTicketsModule` (`fleet/jobs/fleet-jobs.module.ts:24`), which imports `KnowledgeModule` (`fleet/tickets/fleet-tickets.module.ts:21`). The reads are read-only and stay inside the module-private repository. `KnowledgeRunOutcomes = { job: { id, projectId, repoId, owner, name, feature, resultSha: string | null }, outcomes: RunOutcomeRow[] }` holds the rows of the job's latest ingested epoch: the highest `leaseEpoch` among the job's `FleetBundleIngest` rows whose `status` is `done` or `partial`, with `outcomes` empty when that epoch has no outcome row (so a newer bundle without a report retires the older one); null for an unknown job. The remaining D4 method, describeJobs, is implemented by US-005.

3c-2-D6 (outcome chunk rows): an outcome chunk is one `LanceRecord` in `project_<projectId>`: `source = 'outcome'`, `source_id = outcome:<repoId>:<jobId>:<kind>`, `id = <source_id>#<chunkIndex>`, `content` = the context line `<owner>/<name> · run <jobId> · <feature> · <path>` (plus ` · <headingPath>` when non-empty), a newline, the abstract, a blank line, then the chunk text; `metadata` = `JSON.stringify` of `{ repoId, owner, name, path, sha, blobSha: '', jobId, feature, outcomeKind, title, headingPath, anchor, chunkIndex, chunkCount, abstract, text }` where `path` is `feature-report.md` or `decisions.jsonl`, `outcomeKind` is `report` or `decisions`, and `sha` is the job's `resultSha` or `''`; vector, `provider` and `model` follow 1c-c-D4 (unembedded = `provider: 'none'` and a zero vector). `KnowledgeChunkMetadata` (`knowledge-chunk-store.ts:31-48`) gains optional `jobId`, `feature` and `outcomeKind`.

3c-2-D7 (outcome indexing): `KnowledgeRepoIndexer` gains `indexOutcomes(jobId: string, now = new Date()): Promise<OutcomePassResult>`, `OutcomePassResult = { status: 'indexed' | 'skipped' | 'failed'; reason?: string }`:
1. `findRunOutcomes(jobId)`; null resolves `{ status: 'skipped', reason: 'unknown job' }` and writes nothing.
2. For `report` then `decisions`: when the job has that outcome, the chunks are `chunkMarkdown({ path: 'feature-report.md', text })` or `chunkDecisions(text)`; contents are embedded with the existing private `embedAll` (batches of `KNOWLEDGE_EMBED_BATCH`, `EMBED_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`, `FILE_EMBED_DEADLINE_MS` per outcome file) and the rows written with `KnowledgeChunkStore.replaceFile(projectId, sourceId, rows)`. When the job has no such outcome, or its chunk list is empty, `deleteFile(projectId, sourceId)` removes any earlier rows.
3. After both, `RagService.optimizeTable(projectId)` runs once; the pass resolves `indexed`.
4. Any thrown error resolves `{ status: 'failed', reason }` with the message cut to 500 characters.
No `KnowledgeRepoIndex` or `KnowledgeRepoFile` state is written for outcomes. Outcomes are indexed whatever the job's repository host: they are read from Postgres, not from the forge. The two outcome files are written one after the other on purpose: they share one embedding server, the reason `embedAll` is sequential.

3c-2-D8 (outcome queue and trigger): `KnowledgeIndexQueue` gains `enqueueOutcomes(jobId: string): void`. It adds the key `job:<jobId>` to the same waiting set as repository ids (one FIFO, one pass at a time, the 1000-entry cap, a key already waiting is not added twice, a no-op when `knowledgeIndexEnabled` is false, never throws); the drain runs `indexOutcomes(jobId)` for a `job:` key and `indexRepo(repoId)` for any other, and logs a `failed` result with `Logger.warn`. `IngestModule` (`apps/api/src/fleet/ingest/ingest.module.ts`) imports `KnowledgeModule` (no cycle: `KnowledgeModule` imports neither `IngestModule` nor `FleetJobsModule`; its existing imports do include the fleet `GitBrokerModule`). `BundleIngestService` gains a tenth constructor dependency `knowledge: KnowledgeIndexQueue` and, after the ingest transaction commits for a job whose `command` is `RUN`, calls `knowledge.enqueueOutcomes(job.id)` once per ingest.

**Scope** — In: latest-successful-ingest outcome lookup and its domain shape; metadata; sequential outcome pass; shared queue dispatch; explicit IngestModule DI import; post-commit RUN enqueue and producer/consumer seam tests. userStories.title: Search over outcomes
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Search docs and RUN outcomes together or separately, enriching outcome hits with current project-fenced job and PR state.

**Motivation** — 3c-1 made a project's repository docs searchable, but the record of what fleet runs actually did is still out of reach.

**Approach** — 3c-2-D4 (outcome reads): `IKnowledgeIndexRepository` gains `findRunOutcomes(jobId): Promise<KnowledgeRunOutcomes | null>` and `describeJobs(projectId, jobIds: string[]): Promise<KnowledgeJobInfo[]>`, the knowledge repository reading fleet tables directly as its 3c-1 `findProjectRepos` already reads `FleetRepo`. This is a recorded exception to the cross-module rule of `.nax/rules/api-data.md` (call the owning module's service): `KnowledgeModule` cannot import `FleetJobsModule`, because `FleetJobsModule` imports `FleetTicketsModule` (`fleet/jobs/fleet-jobs.module.ts:24`), which imports `KnowledgeModule` (`fleet/tickets/fleet-tickets.module.ts:21`). The reads are read-only and stay inside the module-private repository. `KnowledgeRunOutcomes = { job: { id, projectId, repoId, owner, name, feature, resultSha: string | null }, outcomes: RunOutcomeRow[] }` holds the rows of the job's latest ingested epoch: the highest `leaseEpoch` among the job's `FleetBundleIngest` rows whose `status` is `done` or `partial`, with `outcomes` empty when that epoch has no outcome row (so a newer bundle without a report retires the older one); null for an unknown job. `KnowledgeJobInfo = { jobId, repoId, feature, state, prUrl: string | null, prState: string | null }`, with `prUrl` = `FleetJob.resultPrUrl` and `prState` = the `prState` of the job's most recently updated `TicketLink` with `source = 'fleet'` and non-null `prState` (ordered `prUpdatedAt` desc, then `id`), else null; only jobs of `projectId` are returned. It runs two bounded queries: the jobs (`where id in jobIds and projectId`, `take: 200`) and their fleet links (`where jobId in jobIds, source 'fleet', prState not null`, ordered `prUpdatedAt` desc then `id`, `take: 1000`), keeping the first link per job. `KnowledgeIndexService` gains `describeJobs(projectId, jobIds)` passing through. The findRunOutcomes producer is already supplied by US-004; implement the describeJobs portion here.

3c-2-D9 (search over outcomes): `KnowledgeSearchQuery` (`knowledge-search.service.ts:38-45`) gains `source?: 'docs' | 'outcomes' | 'all'`, default `all`. With `D` = `source = 'repo'` (plus ` AND source_id LIKE 'repo:<repoId>:%'` when `repoId` is given) and `O` = `source = 'outcome'` (plus ` AND source_id LIKE 'outcome:<repoId>:%'`): the lexical predicate is `D` for `docs`, `O` for `outcomes` and `(D) OR (O)` for `all`; the vector predicate is the 3c-1 form for `docs` (`source = 'repo' AND provider != 'none'` plus the repository clause, unchanged), `source = 'outcome' AND provider != 'none'` plus the repository clause for `outcomes`, and `(<docs form>) OR (<outcomes form>)` for `all`. After fusion, in order: hits of a repository not in `listProjectRepos` are dropped (3c-1); when `pathPrefix` is given, outcome hits are dropped and doc hits filtered by prefix (3c-1), so `source: 'outcomes'` with a `pathPrefix` answers no hit; `describeJobs(projectId, <outcome hit job ids>)` is called once when any outcome hit remains, and outcome hits whose job it does not return are dropped; the list is cut to `limit`. `KnowledgeHit` (`:22-36`) gains `source: 'repo' | 'outcome'`, derived from the row's `sourceId` prefix (`outcome:` is `outcome`, anything else `repo`; `KnowledgeChunkRow` is unchanged), and, on outcome hits only, `jobId`, `feature`, `outcomeKind`, `jobState`, `prState` (string or null) and `prUrl` (string or null). `empty` is true when no hit answers and the table holds no row of the asked sources: `KnowledgeChunkStore.hasRepoRows` for `docs`, a new `hasOutcomeRows(projectId)` for `outcomes`, either for `all`. `KnowledgeSearchService` gains `readOutcome(projectId, jobId, path): Promise<KnowledgeChunkRow[]>`: `describeJobs(projectId, [jobId])`; no job answers `[]`; else `readFile(projectId, 'outcome:<repoId>:<jobId>:<kind>')` with `kind` `report` for `feature-report.md` and `decisions` for `decisions.jsonl`.

3c-2-D10 (search route and eval): the `POST search` body (`parseKnowledgeSearchInput`, `:72`) gains `source?: 'docs' | 'outcomes' | 'all'`; another value answers 400 `knowledge.input`; the route passes `source` to the service only when the body has it. `KnowledgeHitDto` gains the D9 fields, each with `@ApiProperty` (optional ones `required: false`). The `kb:eval` script (`apps/api/scripts/kb-eval.ts:179`) sends `source: 'docs'` so its scores stay comparable with the 3c-1 baseline.

**Scope** — In: bounded read-only job/PR enrichment and its service facade; source predicates and parsing; post-fusion fencing; source-aware table emptiness; project-fenced outcome document reads; REST DTOs and docs-only eval body; generated API contract and regression fixture adjustments. Preserve RRF, lexical-only fallback and fix #287's missing-FTS-index-only rebuild. Pin existing 3c-1 predicate/empty unit cases to source:'docs', add source:'repo' to exact doc-hit expectations and endpoint HIT. Code inspection additionally found typed KnowledgeHit literals in project-knowledge.controller.spec.ts and assistant/tools/kb-tools.spec.ts; give those source:'repo' in this story so downstream US-006 is not needed to compile the new required type, preserving their existing behavior assertions. Change only the eval request-body expectation to add source:'docs'. Regenerate openapi.json via bun run api:export-spec and the ignored CLI client via bun run generate. Out: outcome storage/indexing already supplied by US-001/US-004, patterns in US-002, agent formatting/descriptors in US-006, and web in US-007. Ticket search, the existing `/kb` web page and its routes are unchanged (1c-c-R6). The `kb:eval` questions and scoring are unchanged; the script searches `docs` only. US-005 only: job and pull request state are read per search, not cached; a search describes at most 200 job ids, the first 200 outcome hits in rank order, and drops the outcome hits past them.

**Interface** — `describeJobs(projectId, jobIds: string[]): Promise<KnowledgeJobInfo[]>`; `KnowledgeJobInfo = { jobId, repoId, feature, state, prUrl: string | null, prState: string | null }`; `KnowledgeSearchQuery.source?: 'docs' | 'outcomes' | 'all'`; `KnowledgeHit.source: 'repo' | 'outcome'`; `readOutcome(projectId, jobId, path): Promise<KnowledgeChunkRow[]>`; `hasOutcomeRows(projectId)`; `KnowledgeIndexService.describeJobs(projectId, jobIds)`. Only outcome hits carry jobId, feature, outcomeKind, jobState, prState and prUrl.

**Verification** — Extend knowledge-search.service.spec.ts and existing Prisma repository tests; exercise live PR ordering/project isolation in PG and real LanceDB source separation with fake embeddings in knowledge-store.integration.spec.ts. Put source validation/pass-through route cases in test/e2e/api-endpoint/endpoint.e2e.spec.ts. Reuse kb-eval.spec.ts to pin the unchanged evaluation protocol apart from the docs filter. No new production file is required.

When `empty`, the answer is `knowledge index is empty for this project` for `docs` and `all` (3c-1 text) and `no run outcomes are indexed for this project` for `outcomes`. `koda_get_doc` also accepts a citation matching `^job:([a-z0-9]{20,40})\/(feature-report\.md|decisions\.jsonl)(?:#([a-z0-9_-]+))?$`; it reads `KnowledgeSearchService.readOutcome(ctx.projectId, jobId, path)`, applies the 3c-1 anchor and part rules and the chunk-0 rule (`documentText`, `kb-tools.ts:222`) to `feature-report.md` only, because chunk 0 of `decisions.jsonl` is a decision, not a summary, and answers a line `job:/ () part

userStories.title: Knowledge settings tab and citation links
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add a project Knowledge settings tab with repository state and ADMIN actions, and link knowledge citations in sanitized thread replies.

**Motivation** — And the index has no human surface: an admin re-indexes with `curl`, and a citation in a thread reply is plain text.

**Approach** — 3c-2-D12 (web settings): `apps/web/pages/[project]/settings.vue` gains a fourth tab `knowledge` (after `skills`, `:85-87`; the tab list's `grid-cols-3` at `:78` becomes `grid-cols-4`) rendering `SettingsKnowledgeCard` (`apps/web/components/SettingsKnowledgeCard.vue`, prop `slug`). The card loads `GET /projects/<slug>/knowledge/repos` through `useApi()` and `apiPath`; when `enabled` is false it shows a notice (`data-testid="knowledge-disabled"`). It renders one row per repository (`data-testid="knowledge-repo-<repoId>"`) with `owner/name`, `status`, the first 7 characters of `indexedSha`, `fileCount`, `chunkCount`, `unembeddedCount`, `skippedCount`, `lastError` and `finishedAt`. For a global admin (`useAuth().user.value?.role === 'ADMIN'`, the `CommandPalette.vue:15` rule) and only when `enabled`, each row has a re-index button that posts `/projects/<slug>/knowledge/repos/<repoId>/reindex`, toasts success and reloads the state. The patterns editor is a textarea (`data-testid="knowledge-patterns"`) holding `patterns` one per line, editable only by a global admin; Save sends `PUT /projects/<slug>/knowledge/patterns` with `{ patterns: <non-empty trimmed lines> }`, Reset to default sends `{ patterns: null }`; both toast and reload; a failure toasts `extractApiError(err)`. The form is validated with a zod schema (1 to 50 non-empty lines, each ending in `.md`) whose messages are i18n keys. Strings live under a `knowledge` group in `apps/web/i18n/locales/en.json` and `zh.json`.

3c-2-D13 (web citation links): `renderThreadMarkdown` (`apps/web/lib/thread-markdown.ts:203`) also links, under the existing standalone rule (`CONTINUES_PATH`, `:41`) and the code-span rule (`wholePath`, `:51`): a document citation `<owner>/<name>:<path>@<sha>[#<fragment>]` (owner and name `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+`, path without `@`, `#` or whitespace, sha 7-40 lower-case hex, fragment `[A-Za-z0-9_-]+`) to `https://github.com/<owner>/<name>/blob/<sha>/<path>[#<fragment>]` with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`; and an outcome citation `job:<jobId>/(feature-report.md|decisions.jsonl)[#<fragment>]` to `/<slug>/fleet/jobs/<jobId>`. Like the path links, citations are linked only when a slug is given (`:205`). The link text is the citation; the result still passes `sanitizeHtmlFragment` (whose `ALLOWED_URI_REGEXP`, `apps/web/lib/markdown.ts:19`, admits `https:` and `/`).

**Scope** — In: the new slug-prop card; fourth settings tab; load/error/retry and action-triggered refresh; repository state fields; global-ADMIN controls and read-only member view; zod validation and both locales; citation recognition integrated with the existing SSR-safe text-token/code-span scanner and sanitizer; component/page/link regression tests. Update settings-skills-tab.spec.ts's three-trigger title/assertion to four in order project/vcs/skills/knowledge; preserve its other tests. Mirror SettingsProjectCard's useApi/apiPath/toast conventions and the mountSfc test harness. Read docs/ux/redesign/MASTER-PLAN.md before the settings layout change and update its Status table/Decisions log in the same PR; do not redesign the shell. Out: API pattern/persistence/permission work in US-002, outcome indexing in US-004, search/readOutcome in US-005 and agent tool strings/descriptors in US-006. No web search page over the knowledge index; agents search through tools, admins through the REST route. Citation links target GitHub only; GitLab repositories' docs are not indexed (3c-1), though their RUN outcomes are. Ticket search, the existing `/kb` web page and its routes are unchanged (1c-c-R6). US-007 only: the web card does not poll; it reloads after an action or a page visit.

**Interface** — `SettingsKnowledgeCard` prop `slug`; `GET /projects/<slug>/knowledge/repos` reads `enabled`, `repos`, `patterns`, `customPatterns`, `defaultPatterns`; `POST /projects/<slug>/knowledge/repos/<repoId>/reindex`; `PUT /projects/<slug>/knowledge/patterns` with `{ patterns: <non-empty trimmed lines> }` or `{ patterns: null }`; `renderThreadMarkdown(content: string, slug?: string): string`. Preserve the final sanitizeHtmlFragment boundary, image stripping, existing-link/pre/code exclusions and whole-inline-code rule.
